answer_1.quote: We generate contextualized questions grounded on the event of interest... We generate five questions and employ transformers to identify answers that pinpoint the argument (i.e., oil) or, alternatively, indicate that there is no answer.
answer_1.outputs: Generated natural-language questions for each event role

answer_2.quote: All our fine‑tuned BART models are evaluated using the official evaluation scripts... we use P, R, and F1 after comparing (exact match) predictions and the ground truth based on token spans.

answer_3.quote: Our methodology uses LLMs to generate questions; these questions are used (a) fine‑tune T5 for question generation and (b) BART for event‑argument extraction.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a manual analysis of 100 random questions generated... This analysis evaluates the generated questions for their relevance and accuracy in relation to the events and argument roles detailed within the document.
answer_4.guideline: Human evaluators examined each generated question for relevance to the event and argument role and for accuracy of the information extracted.
